description: This file defines the 'PatientProgram' class within the 'org.openmrs' package, representing a patient's enrollment in a medical program, including methods for managing patient states, transitions, attributes, and related data.

classes.name: PatientProgram
classes.description: Represents a patient's participation in a care program within the OpenMRS system, including enrollment details, current states, and attributes.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of this PatientProgram object, including deep copy of states.

methods.name: copyHelper
methods.description: Helper method to copy properties of one PatientProgram instance into another.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Checks if the patient enrollment is active on a specific date.

methods.name: getPatientState
methods.description: Returns the PatientState matching a given state ID.

methods.name: transitionToState
methods.description: Transitions the patient's program to a new state within a workflow, enforcing transition rules.

methods.name: voidLastState
methods.description: Voids the most recent PatientState, adjusting related end dates.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current active state within a specified workflow.

methods.name: getCurrentStates
methods.description: Returns all current active states for the patient program.

methods.name: getMostRecentStateInEachWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the most recent state for each workflow within the patient program.

methods.name: statesInWorkflow
methods.description: Lists all states within a specific workflow, optionally including voided states.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: String representation of the PatientProgram instance.

methods.name: getOutcome
methods.description: Gets the outcome concept for the program.

methods.name: setOutcome
methods.description: Sets the outcome concept for the program.

methods.name: getDateCompleted
methods.description: Returns the date the program was completed.

methods.name: setDateCompleted
methods.description: Sets the completion date of the program.

methods.name: getDateEnrolled
methods.description: Returns the enrollment date.

methods.name: setDateEnrolled
methods.description: Sets the enrollment date.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Returns the patient associated with the program.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Associates a patient with this program.

methods.name: getPatientProgramId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the patient program.

methods.name: setPatientProgramId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the patient program.

methods.name: getProgram
methods.description: Returns the program associated with this patient enrollment.

methods.name: setProgram
methods.description: Associates a program with this patient enrollment.

methods.name: getStates
methods.description: Returns all states associated with this patient program.

methods.name: setStates
methods.description: Sets the collection of states for this program.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the unique identifier (ID) of this object (since version 1.5).

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier (ID) of this object (since version 1.5).

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location associated with the program enrollment (since version 1.8).

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the location associated with the program enrollment (since version 1.8).

methods.name: getSortedStates
methods.description: Returns a list of states sorted by their natural ordering.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the set of all attributes associated with this program.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Returns all active (non-voided) attributes.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Returns all active attributes matching a specific attribute type.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the program.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the collection of attributes.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets or updates an attribute, managing voided state as needed.
